issues.summary: B2B Customer Onboarding — Sales-created accounts, no guest checkout (WBS 3.18.3)
issues.description:
New (decision 2026-10-06, B2B only).

* Sales creates the customer (company, tax code, contacts, payment terms) and invites the customer to activate a portal account. Open self-registration either goes away or ends in "pending approval".
* **Disable guest checkout** — `GuestCheckoutController` (`/api/v1/orders/guest-checkout`) and the public registration endpoint (`/api/v1/customers/registrations`) exist on develop today.
* The storefront availability endpoint on branch SCRUM-158 (`/api/v1/public/products/availability`) must require a customer login instead of being public.

**Owner: not decided yet.** Plan §4.
